The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as the Menologion of Basil II miniature of Cecilia, Valerian and Tiburtius, Constantinople 985, Vatican Library. The Menologion sets that group at 22 November, which is this folder's Greek feast, and Valerian is named there as Cecilia's husband. He is shown with the other two, not alone. Commons describes it: Константинополь. 985 г. Миниатюра Минология Василия II.  Ватиканская библиотека. Рим.
